definitions.airport: Nearest US airport that OurAirports classes as large_airport with scheduled service and 'International'/'Intercontinental' in its name (plus Detroit Metropolitan), excluding 15 airports that carry 'International' in the name but have little or no regular overseas service (MDW, LGB, SNA, ONT, SBD, SFB, PIE, PSP, PNS, MYR, SRQ, FAT, RNO, GSO, DJT). Straight-line (great-circle) miles from the campus lat/lng, NOT driving distance.
definitions.climate_tag: From NOAA 1991-2020 monthly normals (nearest full station): winter = mean over Dec, Jan, Feb of (monthly mean high + monthly mean low)/2; summer_high = mean of Jun, Jul, Aug monthly mean highs. Hot: summer_high >= 95F (overrides the others). Otherwise Mild winters: winter >= 45F; Has seasons: 30F <= winter < 45F; Cold winters: winter < 30F.
definitions.big_sport_tag: D1 FBS football / D1 FCS football / D1 no football / D2 / D3 / NAIA / none, from athletics_division + football_level.
